> specify manually all the types of all the functions
This is usually encouraged in OCaml, in the form of a .mli file.

I think types can be a lot more than "compiler checked documentation that can also work as basic tests". They allow you to encode invariants that allow the compiler to check more than basic stuff. I thought this video had a good example. [link]
